title: Echopoint gate red, prod held: the gate ran two tagged function flows without their caller's inputs
summary: At 03:32Z two new function flows, `Throwaway organization` and `Delete throwaway organization`, were saved with the `echopoint` gate tag. The echopoint post-deploy gate of #938 (04:01Z) selected them, ran each alone with no inputs, and both failed `INPUT_REQUIRED`; the other 102 flows passed. The gate held prod echopoint on d0d34f35, so #938 (drops `flow_versions.published_at`) stayed on dev only. The gate never passed the Action's `ignore-modules`, which defaults to false, while monitors skip functions by default. ci-workflows now skips function flows by default, the local suite script does the same and warns on a tagged function, and the flow-suite skill says functions stay out of gate selections.

impact.text: Dev only. Prod echopoint promotion was held from 04:05Z; #938 stayed on dev. No customer impact: prod kept the previous build. Every later echopoint backend change would have stopped at dev the same way.

trigger: The echopoint gate of Deploy Router run 44863900081 (#938) ran the two tagged function flows alone; each failed `INPUT_REQUIRED` in under 1 s.
detection: The gate's `alert-deploy-failure` job ran at 04:05Z, during the night. The echopoint-investigation routine found it at 06:12Z on its next 6-hourly run. Nothing ran the gate selection between the tag change (03:32Z) and the next deploy.
resolution: ci-workflows `echopoint-test.yml` passes `ignore-modules: true` by default, so the next echopoint gate skips function flows. Prod receives #938 at the next green echopoint gate (next backend merge or a rerun by a human); the routine does not rerun gates.

whys.problem: Prod echopoint promotion was held: the post-deploy gate of #938 went red on dev

because.text: Two flows in the gate tag failed INPUT_REQUIRED in under 1 s; no product check failed
because.evidence: Gate log: `✗ Flow 765223ce…: failed (3ms)` `input "name" is required`; 102 `✓ Flow` lines

because.text: Both are function flows: their input nodes need a caller's values, and the gate ran them alone
because.evidence: `flows get`: `role: function`, nodes `input` … `output`; caller `c62760dd` passes `name`/`orgId` and passed in the same gate

because.text: The gate selects every flow the tag matches, functions included
echopoint-test.yml never set the Action's ignore-modules, whose default is false
because.evidence: ci-workflows `echopoint-test.yml` at main: no `ignore-modules`; echopoint-cli `flow_run.go` flag default false

because.text: Gate selection differs from monitor selection: monitors skip functions by default, the gate had no such default
The functions carried the product gate tag
because.evidence: `tags: ["echopoint"]` on both; the other 15 functions in the workspace are untagged

because.text: Suite guidance says to tag each new flow with its product and says nothing about functions
because.evidence: skills `flow-suite-testing/SKILL.md` step 8 ("Connect the gate"); routine step 4 "tag it with its product"

because.text: No rule or check keeps reusable function flows out of a gate selection tag
Prod stayed held for hours, and only the next deploy revealed the broken selection
because.evidence: Tag change 03:32Z; first run of the tag 04:01Z inside a deploy; routine run 06:12Z

because.text: Nothing runs the gate selection when a flow's tags change
because.evidence: Gate runs only from Deploy Router; run_suites.sh runs every 6 h; same gap as the 2026-11-21 role-rename postmortem A7

because.text: A tag edit is a gate change with no check of its own before the next deploy
A red gate holds prod until the next merge or a human rerun
because.evidence: Routine rule: it does not rerun a failed gate job (a rerun promotes to prod)

because.text: No owner reruns a gate whose failure was fixed outside the product (config or flow)

contributing: The role rename (echopoint#930, 2026-11-20) made functions first-class one day earlier, and another session converted the throwaway-org pattern into functions overnight.
The local suite script `run_suites.sh` also ran tags without `--ignore-modules`, so it would have failed the same way instead of matching monitors.

well: The gate verdict named both flows and the exact input error, so the cause was clear from one log.
The caller flow `c62760dd` passed in the same gate: the functions themselves work.
wrong: Gate, monitors and the local script each chose their own flow selection rule.
The tag change and the deploy were 22 minutes apart, and nobody ran the tag in between.
lucky: The held change was a column drop with no prod caller; a held security fix would have stayed off prod the same way.
Both functions fail fast and own nothing before their input check, so the failed runs leaked no organization.

actions.what: echopoint-test.yml input `ignore_modules`, default true, passed to the Action (gate skips function flows)
run_suites.sh passes `--ignore-modules` and prints `FUNCTION-IN-TAG <tag> <flow>` for a tagged function
flow-suite-testing skill: a reusable function stays out of the gate selection; the selection skips functions
Run the gate tag when a flow in it is saved with a new tag or role (pre-deploy selection check)
Name an owner who reruns a gate whose failure was fixed outside the product

messaging.internal: Echopoint gate of #938 red on two function flows tagged echopoint (no inputs); prod held on d0d34f35. Gate now skips function flows by default; prod gets #938 at the next green echopoint gate.
